# Vendored dependencies

## three.module.min.js

- **Library:** three.js (https://threejs.org)
- **Version:** 0.170.0 (r170)
- **Source:** https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.min.js
- **Licence:** MIT — https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/LICENSE

Self-hosted so the site keeps no third-party runtime dependency and the
version can never drift. Loaded only when a visitor clicks the island
button — never on normal page views. To upgrade, replace the file with a
newer pinned build and update this note.
